comment: GNSS/GPS policy for the S10+ (beyond2lte), Exynos 9820. The BCM4773 receiver is reached through the Broadcom BBD/LHD RPC stack: /dev/ttyBCM is the BBD packet transport, NOT an NMEA serial port; /dev/bbd_patch is the sensor-hub patch firmware loader used by the vendor lhd daemon; the vendor gpsd/lhd pair is Android/Bionic + HIDL. Stages are device node -> driver binding -> compatible firmware -> BBD/LHD userspace -> protocol exchange -> position fix. A readable node, a bound SPI driver or an SPI register response is never a fix. No coordinate is ever fabricated; an outdoor owner test is required for GNSS PASS.

device.soc: Exynos 9820 (integrated GNSS path; vendor userspace required for assisted fix)

stream.note: Do not parse NMEA on /dev/ttyBCM; use the BBD/LHD userspace provider.

userspace.protocol_reader_blocker: No native BBD/LHD RPC decoder in the repository; the vendor implementations are Android/Bionic.

evidence_sources.firmware_absent_reason: The vendor blob set contains lhd/gpsd/lhd.conf/gps.xml but no BBD sensor-hub patch. The stock BBD patch is an Android system/vendor artifact (lhd.conf comments reference /system/bin/bcm_sensorhub_a1.patch) and is not present on the Nuxel Fedora rootfs.

verdicts.READY_FOR_SKY: compatible protocol provider is running and protocol-valid position data was observed; an owner outdoors may wait for a fix (still NEEDS_OWNER_TEST)
verdicts.BLOCKED_KERNEL: no GNSS device node and no GNSS driver module bound
verdicts.BLOCKED_FIRMWARE: driver/node path exists but no compatible BCM4773 BBD sensor-hub patch firmware is present
verdicts.BLOCKED_EXTERNAL_RESOURCE: kernel GNSS up but no compatible userspace consumer/reader is installed
verdicts.NO_FIX: a valid protocol stream exists but no fresh position has been decoded
verdicts.PARTIAL: some stages present, some missing - read the per-stage lines
verdicts.BLOCKED_VENDOR_RUNTIME: firmware/provider prerequisites exist but the Android/Bionic lhd+gpsd+HIDL runtime is missing
verdicts.BLOCKED_PROTOCOL: BCM4773 BBD/LHD transport exists but no compatible protocol implementation is available; NMEA/gpsd is not a substitute

fix_test.comment: Owner procedure only. The repository scripts the monitor and protocol diagnostics; it never prints a coordinate it did not read, never treats BBD bytes or SPI responses as a fix, and never claims a fix indoors.
steps: go outdoors with a clear view of the sky
start the BBD/LHD provider (native or isolated vendor runtime) and a bounded cold-start acquisition
wait up to 300 s for a provider GPS/GNSS source and a provider timestamp
cross-check the coordinate against the offline OSM map
record coordinate, accuracy, time-to-first-fix and source in the restricted evidence file
evidence_required_for_promotion: BBD/LHD provider reports protocol exchange success
a fresh position with provider timestamp and source=gps/gnss
coordinate agrees with the offline map within reported accuracy
time-to-first-fix and cold/warm start are recorded

offline_map.comment: Offline-first OSM integration: the Maps app must work with cached/offline tiles and must NOT require network for a cached area. The repository ships the tile layout policy and the attribution; it ships no fabricated map data.
